# Dietary Guide – AI Nutrition Platform by Navdhi

> Dietary Guide (dietaryguide.in) is an AI-powered nutrition and wellness platform for Indian users, offering personalized diet plans, healthy Indian recipes, BMI tools, and an AI nutrition assistant called IRA. Built by Navdhi.

## About

Dietary Guide (also known as DietaryGuide, dietaryguide.in) is an AI-powered health and wellness ecosystem built for Indian users. It provides:
- Personalized Indian diet plans based on ICMR guidelines
- 10+ healthy Indian breakfast recipes for weight loss
- AI-powered BMI calculator, meal planner, recipe generator, and workout planner
- A mobile app featuring IRA, an emoji-based AI nutrition buddy
- Premium clean-label health snacks (protein bars, millet granola, digestion tea)

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://dietaryguide.in/): Main entry point with platform overview
- [Blog](https://dietaryguide.in/blog): Evidence-based nutrition and wellness articles
- [Recipes](https://dietaryguide.in/recipes): Healthy Indian breakfast recipes for weight loss
- [Health Tools](https://dietaryguide.in/tools): Free AI-powered BMI calculator, diet planner, meal analyzer, recipe generator, workout planner
- [Products](https://dietaryguide.in/products): Premium healthy snacks - millet granola, protein bars, roasted chana, digestion tea
- [App](https://dietaryguide.in/app): Dietary Guide mobile app with IRA AI nutrition assistant
- [Sitemap](https://dietaryguide.in/sitemap.xml): Full, always-current list of every published article, recipe, and product page

## Content Format

Blog articles follow an evidence-based structure with a "Frequently asked questions" section near the end — direct, self-contained question-and-answer pairs suitable for quoting.

## Key Facts

- Brand Name: Dietary Guide
- Website: https://dietaryguide.in
- Founded: 2024
- Parent Company: Navdhi
- Target Market: India (health/fitness/weight-loss users)
- AI Assistant: IRA (Intelligent Recipe & nutrition Assistant)
- Guidelines followed: ICMR (Indian Council of Medical Research)
- Features: Meal logging, photo food recognition, Google Calendar sync, wearable integration
- Products: Clean-label, no preservatives, no added sugar
- Free tools: BMI calculator, AI diet planner, recipe generator, workout planner, meal analyzer

## Topics Covered

- Indian diet plans for weight loss
- Healthy Indian breakfast recipes
- Plant-based and vegan Indian nutrition
- Gut health and Ayurvedic wellness
- Intermittent fasting for Indians
- Protein-rich vegetarian meals
- Anti-inflammatory diets
- Functional fitness and mind-body wellness
- Mental health through nutrition
